en.title: Check the Computer for CMSY++ and Choose the Settings for It
en.description:
This function finds the operating system, R version and processor of the computer, checks
whether JAGS and the R packages that CMSY++ needs are installed, and shows the settings that
`cmsy_run()` will use on this system.
en.details:
The CMSY++ code (`CMSY++16.R`) was written on Windows. Its user guide (step 12) tells Mac users
to change every `windows()` call to `quartz()` and `antialias = "cleartype"` to
`antialias = "default"`, and to comment out `windows()` on other systems. The code tests for
Windows with `grepl("win", sysname)`, which is also true for macOS ("Darwin"), so on a Mac it
calls `windows()` and stops. `cmsy_run()` makes these changes automatically for the system
found here, in a copy of the code; the bundled original is never changed. The other changes,
made on every system, are listed in the `changes` element.

The system is detected automatically. To use the settings of another system (e.g. when the
detection is wrong), set `os`, or set it for the session with
`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_os = "macos")`.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list with the system (`os`, `os_detected`, `arch`, `r_version`), the
installed `jags` and `rjags` versions, the `packages` table, the recommended `jags_installer`
and `rjags_source`, the chart `device` and `antialias` settings, and the `changes`
made to the CMSY++ code.

arguments.os:
The operating system whose settings are used: "auto" (default, detect it),
"windows", "macos" or "linux".
arguments.device:
Where CMSY++ draws its charts before saving them as JPEG files: "file"
(default), an off-screen device that works on every system and in batch runs, or
"screen", the system's own window (`windows()`, `quartz()` or `x11()`).
arguments.jags:
The JAGS version to recommend: "recommended" (default; the newest JAGS 4 release
built for this R version, which works with rjags from CRAN), "latest" (JAGS 5.0.0, which
needs rjags 5-x from SourceForge) or a version number such as "4.3.2".
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If TRUE, no summary is printed. Default is FALSE, or the value
set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

zh.title: 检查本机的CMSY++运行环境并选择相应设置
zh.description: 本函数查明电脑的操作系统、R版本和处理器，检查是否已安装JAGS和CMSY++所需的R包，并显示`cmsy_run()`在该系统上将使用的设置。
zh.details:
CMSY++代码（`CMSY++16.R`）是在Windows上编写的。其用户手册（第12步）要求Mac用户把所有`windows()`调用改为`quartz()`，把`antialias = "cleartype"`改为`antialias = "default"`，在其他系统上则把`windows()`注释掉。代码用`grepl("win", sysname)`判断是否为Windows，而这一判断在macOS（"Darwin"）上也为真，所以在Mac上代码会调用`windows()`并报错停止。`cmsy_run()`会针对本函数检测到的系统，在代码副本中自动完成这些修改；包内的原始代码始终不变。在所有系统上都会进行的其他修改也列在`changes`元素中。

系统是自动检测的。如需使用其他系统的设置（例如检测有误时），可以设置`os`，或用`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_os = "macos")`为本次R会话设置。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包括系统信息（`os`、`os_detected`、`arch`、`r_version`）、已安装的`jags`和`rjags`版本、`packages`表、推荐的`jags_installer`和`rjags_source`、图表的`device`和`antialias`设置，以及对CMSY++代码所做的修改`changes`。

arguments.os: 采用哪个操作系统的设置："auto"（默认，自动检测）、"windows"、"macos"或"linux"。
arguments.device: CMSY++把图表保存为JPEG文件之前在哪里绘制图表："file"（默认），即在所有系统上和批处理运行中都能使用的离屏绘图设备；或"screen"，即系统自己的绘图窗口（`windows()`、`quartz()`或`x11()`）。
arguments.jags: 推荐的JAGS版本："recommended"（默认；针对当前R版本编译的最新JAGS 4版本，可与CRAN上的rjags配合使用）、"latest"（JAGS 5.0.0，需要SourceForge上的rjags 5-x）或版本号，例如"4.3.2"。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出汇总信息。默认为FALSE，或`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。
